scripts.build:packages: yarn generate && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/sdk build && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/ui-components build
scripts.dev: yarn build:packages && concurrently "yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/frontend dev" "cd apps/backend && LWN_ENV=development go run cmd/server/main.go"
scripts.dev:backend: yarn generate && cd apps/backend && LWN_ENV=development go run cmd/server/main.go
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/frontend exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/ui-components exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/sdk exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/desktop compile
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/frontend lint:ts && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/frontend lint:css && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/ui-components lint:ts && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/ui-components lint:css && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/sdk lint && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/desktop lint && yarn workspace @lwn-simulator/desktop-launcher lint
scripts.check: yarn generate && yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test
